id:
Pinjaman memberi uang sekarang, tapi dibayar kembali dengan bunga. Perhatikan cicilan per bulan, total bunga, dan rasio cicilan (DSR, maksimal 35% gaji).

Cicilan ditarik otomatis setiap awal bulan. Telat bayar menurunkan skor kredit, dan menunggak 3 bulan berturut-turut membuat pinjaman macet.
en:
A loan gives you money now, but you pay it back with interest. Check the monthly installment, total interest, and debt service ratio (DSR, at most 35% of salary).

Installments are charged automatically at the start of each month. Late payments lower your credit score, and 3 missed months in a row put the loan in default.

id:
Kendaraan menambah kebahagiaan, tapi nilainya menyusut setiap tahun dan ada biaya rutin: bensin, servis, dan pajak.

Membeli tunai (misalnya lewat Impian) lebih murah daripada kredit, karena kredit menambah bunga di atas nilai yang terus turun.
en:
A vehicle adds happiness, but it loses value every year and has running costs: fuel, servicing, and tax.

Buying with cash (for example through a Dream) is cheaper than credit, because credit adds interest on top of a shrinking value.

id:
Membeli rumah butuh lebih dari harganya: BPHTB + notaris 6% dibayar tunai, lalu PBB & perawatan setiap bulan. Bunga KPR biasanya hanya tetap 3 tahun, setelah itu mengambang.

Menyewa bukan berarti buang uang: bandingkan sewa dengan cicilan, biaya kepemilikan, dan hasil investasi dari uang mukanya.
en:
Buying a home costs more than its price: 6% transfer tax + notary paid in cash, then property tax & upkeep every month. Mortgage rates are usually fixed for only 3 years, then float.

Renting isn't throwing money away: compare rent with installments, ownership costs, and what the down payment could earn if invested.

id:

Tidak ada lagi uang sewa, tapi kini ada cicilan, PBB, dan biaya perawatan setiap bulan. Sisihkan dana untuk perbaikan, karena atap bocor dan keran rusak kini jadi urusanmu.

Welcome to %s, your own home!

No more rent, but now there are installments, property tax, and upkeep every month. Set aside money for repairs: leaky roofs and broken taps are now your problem.

Sebelum memakai leverage, pahami dulu:

• Leverage memperbesar untung DAN rugi. Dengan 10x, harga bergerak 6% melawanmu sudah cukup untuk likuidasi.
• Kerugian bisa melebihi margin. Jika harga melompat karena berita, kekurangannya ditagih dari kas.
• Biaya inap dihitung setiap hari: leverage 10x memakan sekitar 7% margin per bulan.
• Di dunia nyata, sebagian besar trader ritel yang memakai leverage merugi.
• Jangan memakai dana darurat atau uang pinjaman sebagai margin.
en:
Before using leverage, understand this:

• Leverage magnifies gains AND losses. At 10x, a 6% move against you is enough for liquidation.
• Losses can exceed the margin. If the price gaps on news, the shortfall is charged to your cash.
• Financing is charged daily: 10x leverage costs about 7% of margin per month.
• In real life, most retail traders who use leverage lose money.
• Never use your emergency fund or borrowed money as margin.
